name: ui-height-expand
title: Intrinsic Height Expand
description: Bấm tiêu đề, phần nội dung mở ra đúng bằng chiều cao của nó (66 px), mũi tên lật ngược và mục bên dưới bị đẩy xuống theo, không kéo méo chữ.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio auto-height-expand, written here): Header 200x26 r7 'PROJECT DETAILS' with a chevron that rotates 0 → 180°. Content (66 px tall: accent 3 px left bar, a title and two lines) is revealed by a clip whose height goes 0 → 66 px over 0.4-0.95 s power2.inOut (recipe 650 ms); the NEXT SECTION row and the lines under it move down by the same height. Collapse 2.0-2.45 s. Cursor clicks at 0.3 s and 1.9 s. Text is never scaled. Params: height (theo nội dung, 66 px) · duration (0.55 s) · chevron (180°) · ease (power2.inOut). The content keeps its own height (66 units): only the clip opens; the rows below move down by the same amount; text is never scaled.
moworks.titleVi: Mục mở theo chiều cao nội dung
